import sys

def largest_k_multiple_free_subset(n, k, a):
    # Dictionary to store the count of numbers with the same remainder when divided by k
    remainder_count = {}
    
    for num in a:
        remainder = num % k
        if remainder in remainder_count:
            remainder_count[remainder] += 1
        else:
            remainder_count[remainder] = 1
    
    # The size of the largest k-multiple free subset is the maximum count of any remainder
    return max(remainder_count.values())
